# scamp_vm (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing VM by UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the VM to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `cpu_cores` (Number) Number of vCPU cores.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the VM was created.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the VM.
- `ip_internal` (String) Internal IP address.
- `ipv6_address` (String) IPv6 address.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MB.
- `os_user` (String) OS username.
- `primary_network_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the primary network.
- `public_ip_v4` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `public_ip_v6` (String) Public IPv6 address.
- `root_disk_class_id` (Number) ID of the storage class for root disk.
- `root_disk_gb` (Number) Root disk size in GB.
- `ssh_key_id` (Number) ID of the SSH key.
- `state` (String) State of the VM (running, stopped, etc.).
- `status` (String) Status of the VM.
- `vm_class_id` (Number) ID of the VM class.
- `vm_name` (String) System name of the VM.
- `vm_template_id` (Number) ID of the VM template.
